{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= GUI

|descr=Creates cinematic borders. Player cannot move during cutscene.

|s1= [mode, duration, sound, view] call [[BIS_fnc_cinemaBorder]]

|p1= mode: [[Number]] - can be:
*0 - In
*1 - Out
|p2= duration: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 1.5) duration in seconds
|p3= sound: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[true]]) play sound
|p4= view: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) lock 1st-person-view

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>[1, 2, true, true] call BIS_fnc_cinemaBorder;</sqf>

|seealso= [[disableUserInput]] [[userInputDisabled]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Honger
|timestamp= 20221015144335
|text= When cinematic borders are active and player is not provided with any animation, he can abuse the movement lock by vaulting (default button V).
}}
